## Instructions

**Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before doing anything else.** It is the
single source of truth for this project's conventions and for the **mandatory**
Agent Logging Protocol (`AGENT_LOG.md` must be updated in the same change as any
significant edit). This file intentionally duplicates nothing, to avoid drift.

Governance constraints live in `.specify/memory/constitution.md` and win on conflict.
